ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low global ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; the surface is dominated by low-intensity (black) values with high-intensity (white) pixels localized solely at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform low-intensity distribution across 95% of the visible surface area; no high-contrast contiguous geometric blobs or mottling patterns are detected on the main fluke body.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression at the center with a calculated angle of approximately 40 degrees and significant penetration into the fluke's longitudinal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations present across the entire trailing edge of both lobes; characterized by numerous jagged peaks and sharp-bottomed valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve meeting a sharp, upward-turned distal tip on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel clusters (white on black background) located at the extreme left and right distal tips, corresponding to barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization covering both distal tips, creating significant visual texture and perimeter irregularities.
other_distinctive_markers: The ventral surface displays a near-total black pigmentation (All-Black Type) which is highly distinctive compared to typical variegated markings.
